families.decision: Look for organic, grass-fed raw milk where legally sold.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; for cow's milk, add the AGA grassfed seal.
Read raw milk or unpasteurized milk on the bottle.
Pick a bottle naming the small farm that produced the milk.
Check the bottle date, intact cap and refrigerated shelf.

families.decision: Pick plain, full-fat organic cultured dairy from a named grass-fed farm.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and AGA grassfed seals.
Pick a tub or bottle naming the farm that supplies the milk.
Read plain, whole milk or full-fat on the label.
Skip ingredient lists with added sugar, flavors, starch, gums or carrageenan.

families.decision: Look for organic grass-fed raw-milk cheese aged 60+ days where legally sold.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and AGA grassfed seals.
Pick farmstead cheese with the producing farm named on the label.
Read the stated aging time: 60 days or longer.
Read milk, cultures, salt and rennet or enzymes in the ingredient line.

families.decision: Pick organic grass-fed cream, butter or ghee from a named small dairy.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and AGA grassfed seals.
Pick a pack naming the dairy farm that supplied the cream.
Read the ingredient line for added oils, gums and flavorings.
Skip blends listing vegetable oils or natural flavors.

families.decision: Pick organic, unsweetened plant drinks with water and the named plant.
buying_tips: Look for the USDA Organic seal and unsweetened wording.
Read the ingredients for water and the named nut, grain or bean.
Skip added oils, gums, flavors and vitamin or mineral blends.
Pick a carton naming the farm or origin of its nuts, grain or beans.

families.decision: Pick organic, unsweetened whole coconut milk with coconut and water.
buying_tips: Look for organic and whole or full-fat wording.
Read coconut and water in the ingredient line.
Pick an intact can with a named coconut origin.
Skip ingredient lists with sugar, gums or emulsifiers.

families.decision: Pick organic grass-fed ice cream with cream, milk, sugar and real vanilla.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and grass-fed wording.
Pick a tub naming the small dairy farm supplying the milk.
Read ice cream on the front and cream in the ingredients.
Skip ingredient lists with gums, vegetable oils or artificial flavors.

families.decision: Pick organic ferments labeled unpasteurized and kept refrigerated.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and fermented wording.
Read unpasteurized or not heated after fermentation on the label.
Pick a jar or bottle naming the small farm or maker.
Check keep refrigerated wording, the date and an intact seal.

families.decision: Pick organic, named-source fats with the processing method on the label.
buying_tips: Look for extra virgin olive oil, virgin coconut oil or grass-fed dairy fat.
Check the organic seal and named farm or oil origin.
Read every fat and oil in a blend's ingredient line.
Skip hydrogenated fats and added flavorings.

grassfed_butter.decision: Look for organic grass-fed raw butter where legally sold.
grassfed_butter.delta: Cream, with optional salt or cultures.

whole_vs_reduced_fat_milk.decision: Look for organic grass-fed raw whole milk where legally sold.
whole_vs_reduced_fat_milk.delta: Whole milk on the label; skip skim, 1% and 2%.

cheese_real_vs_processed.decision: Look for organic grass-fed raw cheese aged 60+ days where legally sold.
cheese_real_vs_processed.delta: Block or wedge; skip labels saying pasteurized process cheese food.

yogurt_plain_vs_flavored.decision: Pick plain organic grass-fed whole-milk yogurt with milk and cultures.
yogurt_plain_vs_flavored.delta: Greek or unstrained yogurt with milk and cultures; skip fruit-on-the-bottom pots.

raw_milk.decision: Look for organic grass-fed raw milk from a named farm where legally sold.
raw_milk.delta: Read the farm's posted lab results for the sample date and named tests.

cream_vs_creamer.decision: Pick organic grass-fed cream from a named small dairy.
cream_vs_creamer.delta: Cream only in the ingredient line; skip ultra-pasteurized or UHT cartons.

raw_kefir.decision: Look for plain organic grass-fed raw whole-milk kefir where legally sold.
raw_kefir.delta: Read raw milk and kefir grains in the ingredients; skip bottles labeled for pets.

raw_aged_cheese.decision: Look for organic grass-fed raw-milk cheese aged 60+ days where legally sold.
raw_aged_cheese.delta: Imported wedges still need explicit raw or unpasteurized milk wording.

oat_milk.decision: Pick organic unsweetened oat milk made with oats and water.
oat_milk.delta: Check the Added Sugars line on oat cartons, including barista versions.

plain_kefir.decision: Pick plain organic grass-fed whole-milk kefir with live cultures.
plain_kefir.delta: Read kefir grains or kefir yeasts among the listed cultures.

sour_cream.decision: Pick organic grass-fed sour cream made with cream and cultures.
sour_cream.delta: Read cultured cream in the ingredients; skip acidified sour cream.

cream_cheese.decision: Pick plain organic grass-fed cultured cream cheese.
cream_cheese.delta: Read cream cheese on the pack; milk, cream, cultures and salt, with optional lactase.

cottage_cheese.decision: Pick organic grass-fed full-fat cottage cheese with cultured curds.
cottage_cheese.delta: Read the curd and cream-dressing ingredients, including any stabilizer blend.

ice_cream.decision: Pick organic grass-fed ice cream from a named small dairy.
ice_cream.delta: For vanilla, read vanilla bean or vanilla extract; egg yolks fit a custard-style recipe.

ghee.decision: Pick organic grass-fed ghee with butter or butterfat as its only ingredient.
ghee.delta: Read ghee or clarified butter on the jar; cultured ghee starts with cultured butter.

goat_sheep_dairy.decision: Look for organic pasture-raised raw goat or sheep milk where legally sold.
goat_sheep_dairy.delta: Read goat or sheep in the milk description; check blends for cow's milk.

almond_milk.decision: Pick organic unsweetened almond milk made with almonds and water.
almond_milk.delta: Compare the stated almond percentage; pick the higher almond content.

soy_milk.decision: Pick organic unsweetened soy milk made with whole soybeans and water.
soy_milk.delta: Read whole soybeans in the ingredients; skip soy protein isolate.

coconut_milk_beverage.decision: Pick organic unsweetened whole coconut milk made with coconut and water.
coconut_milk_beverage.delta: Carton drinks are diluted; compare the printed coconut percentage.

plant_butter.decision: Pick organic virgin coconut oil for a plant-based solid fat.
plant_butter.delta: For a spread, read every oil listed alongside coconut or olive oil.

dairy_case.decision: Start with organic dairy from a named small farm and read the product type.
dairy_case.delta: Milk, cultured dairy, aged cheese and cream have separate label checks.

groups.title: Raw whole milk
groups.why_same: Both use raw whole-milk wording, organic and grass-fed seals, a named farm and dated test results where legally sold.

groups.title: Raw aged cheese
groups.why_same: Both use explicit raw-milk wording, a named farm, organic and grass-fed sourcing, and a stated age of at least 60 days where legally sold.

groups.title: Plain yogurt and kefir
groups.why_same: Both use plain whole-milk labels, organic and grass-fed sourcing, and a milk-and-cultures ingredient check.

groups.title: Plain oat, almond and soy drinks
groups.why_same: All use the organic seal, unsweetened wording, water plus the named plant, and the same screen for oils, gums and flavorings.
